qualification: PROVISIONAL N08 low-speed planner profile; diagnostic only. The velocity is an upper setpoint bound, not a measured braking lower bound or flight clearance.
rationale: The 0.15 m/s EGO velocity upper bound defines the N08 provisional low-speed comparison only. The 0.25 m/s2 EGO acceleration limit shapes planner output but is not treated as actual PX4 deceleration. The target profile reuses a 0.6 m lateral wall-layout goal with N06 planner-only evidence; every N08 runtime must independently require current N05 admission, current N06 full-curve checks, and a separately measured stopping boundary before executing motion. The N05-derived body inflation and map freshness settings remain unchanged.
